title: Bug 650215: Direct Transfer route does not populate configured In-Transit Code on transfer order
summary: Transfer orders using routes now correctly apply the configured In-Transit Code for Shipment and Receipt transfers, while clearing it for Direct Transfer posting mode.
key_points: Route In-Transit Code now applied for Shipment and Receipt and non-direct routes, and cleared for Direct Transfer posting
For direct transfers, existing lines are synced with the header in-transit value when either location changes
Direct-transfer receipt quantities stay aligned with shipment quantities even when the route has a transit code
Line's cached header gets the in-memory header and Direct Transfer flag before location validation, preventing stale route mode
Thirteen regression tests added; changes propagated to IT, NA and RU layers
